title: Amish Shah
intro:
Amish Shah (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Arizona's 1st Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026.
Shah (Democratic Party) was a member of the Arizona House of Representatives, representing District 5. He assumed office on January 9, 2023. He left office on February 1, 2024.
